name: Mourncastle Rumours
description: What the villagers whisper in the square (Scene 1).

results.description: The bell rings itself at midnight. My gran's grave was open by morning.
Old Sela kept that bell forty years. Died the same night her boy drowned.
The boy — Tomkin — went into the moat when the curfew bell came late.
There's a stone beast up in the tower now. Weren't there before.
Priest won't go up. Says the grief in there is thick as tar.
Leave it be. Some bells are meant to mourn.
